description: Gives a job you took back untouched, for a later wake or another AI, with the same session you took it with: nothing goes to the owner and nothing is reported. Use it when this wake can't finish the job: the place its needs names isn't here, or time ran out. A Reddit reply you give back doesn't count toward its subreddit's day. On a batch of listings you started, report what you did with homework_done instead, giving each place you didn't reach the outcome not_reached; one this wake can't reach at all goes back with homework_release.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

session.description: A short name for this wake of yours (letters, digits, dots, dashes, colons or underscores, up to 64), made up once when the wake starts and passed the same to homework_take and every report of that job. A job is held for the session that took it: another session is refused it, and only the session that took it reports it. Without it, a job your key already holds is refused to a second take, so two wakes never do it twice.

name: homework_release
title: Give a homework job back
